summary: Shopper delivery reads must treat SHPPR019 as a successful empty state rather than a generic API failure.
reason: The authenticated API returns HTTP 400 with SHPPR019 when a store has no upcoming delivery; callers need an empty result so absence of a scheduled delivery does not break read-only workflows.
validated_outcome: Pet delivery summary and calendar return status no_scheduled_delivery with exit 0 while real API errors retain typed non-zero exits.
